name: local-socket-teardown
goal: The teardown of the local transport tests settles a socket it cancels while connecting, surfaces any other socket error, and awaits every socket it owns

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Record of 4d: local-transport.test.ts 6 passed, 1 unhandled error from local-transport-fixture.ts:96. ws raises an error when a CONNECTING socket is terminated; the fixture's page sockets have no listener. The reload test's ended window keeps reconnecting, so a handshake can be in flight at teardown. Probe on unchanged files: 6 of 6 such terminations raised it, 22 of 22 others did not (work/local-socket-teardown/diagnosis)

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Fixture byte-identical (sha 6da31765). test/local-transport-teardown.test.ts (sha b9d9b6fa) holds the page socket CONNECTING behind a handshake barrier. Wrapper command, scenario remote-desktop-boundaries: 1 passed, 1 failed, expected 'not told' to be 'The desktop backend cannot be reached.'; 1 unhandled error, the same as the record, at fixture:96; exit 1. Five of five plain runs alike (work/local-socket-teardown/red)

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: local-transport-fixture.ts only: the teardown is settle(), which waits for everything and then throws what was raised; a page socket has an error listener that takes just the cancellation the teardown itself caused while the socket was connecting, and its end is awaited; attempt() sockets are awaited too. No product source, timeout, assertion or Vitest setting changed

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Red test byte-identical (sha b9d9b6fa) through the wrapper: 2 passed, exit 0, no unhandled error (work/local-socket-teardown/green/wrapper-frozen-red-test.log). Then three guards appended; only its import line differs. Wrapper, scenario checks local-socket 6, local-teardown 5, local-bounds 4, preload-authority 2, recorded transport 2: all exit 0 with assertion captures. The recorded check with handshakes 24 ms late: 6 passed, exit 0

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
Prove that removing the cleanup or hiding other errors fails the lifecycle tests.
steps.evidence: Throwaway copy, lifecycle file against five mutations of the fixture: original teardown 4 failed and 4 unhandled errors; every error swallowed 2 failed; close not awaited 1 failed, CLOSING for CLOSED; socket not ended 3 failed by the unchanged deadlines; cancellation matched by its words alone 1 failed. Repaired fixture: 5 passed, eight runs alike (work/local-socket-teardown/mutants)
